people.name: Gershom
people.line: Son of Moses; father of Jonathan, a renegade priest.

translations.web: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.
translations.bsb: along with her two sons. One son was named Gershom, for Moses had said, “I have been a foreigner in a foreign land.”
translations.kjv: And her two sons; of which the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been an alien in a strange land:
translations.asv: and her two sons; of whom the name of the one was Gershom; for he said, I have been a sojourner in a foreign land:
